# Quirk 7

The same quirk in English: the roll as a badge, the text as the body,
the captions from the `en` tables. Out of the German deck. Invented for
this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: quirk
  language: en
data:
  name: Memory for Names
  roll: "7"
  roll-min: 7
  roll-max: 7
  description: "You always speak of yourself in the third person and never forget a name."
  reference: Rules p. 15
```
